descriptions.zh:
我们与一位名为§H世界之喰煞§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着贪婪的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。

喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、以及冲突和哀嚎的甜美。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HEater of Worlds§!. Insatiable, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Eater hungers impatiently. It craves war, the sweet taste of strife and lament.

喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、以及烈火和废墟的甜美。
descriptions.en:

The Eater hungers impatiently. It craves war, the sweet taste of fire and ruin.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一位名为§H魂灵之月窠§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着和谐的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。

月窠渴求着星系摆脱混沌和冲突，所有住民都致力于实现同一个和平。只有完美的平衡才足够。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HCradle of Souls§!. Harmonious, it grants us crumbs of power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Cradle aches for a galaxy free from chaos and conflict, with all its denizens bent towards the unifying goal of peace. Only perfect balance will suffice.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一位名为§H生命之织缕§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

织缕渴求基因操控和将血肉从进化的桎梏中解脱。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HComposer of Strands§!. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for genetic manipulations and flesh set free from the constraints of evolution. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HComposer of Strands§!. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for manipulations of the physical form, and growth set free from conventional restraints. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

我们与一个名为§H渴求之器具§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

器具渴求着渴求本身。沉溺享乐、腐化和奴役便是器具的别名。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HInstrument of Desire§!. Pampering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Instrument longs for yearning. Indulged pleasures, decadence, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一位名为§H虚空之低语§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着莫测的感觉，它索取一定代价承诺赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。

低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。
descriptions.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Unfathomable, it promises to grant us crumbs of power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

descriptions.zh:
我们与§R轮回之终末§!的契约给§H[this.GetName]§!带来了毁灭，余下的只有我们往昔强盛帝国的断壁残垣。

超主的破坏欲具现化为一个强大的能量生物——§R最终清算§!。它在星球之间漫游，吞噬人口来重获自己的力量。
descriptions.en:
Our Covenant with the §REnd of the Cycle§! led to the destruction of the §H[this.GetName]§!, leaving behind only a vestige of our once-powerful empire.

The destructive intent of our former patron has now taken form as an immense energy being - the §RReckoning§!. It moves from world to world, restoring its strength by consumption of their populations.

descriptions.zh: §H[event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]§!的清算正在给整个星系带来浩劫！
descriptions.en: The Reckoning of the §H[event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]§! is wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

descriptions.zh: 有许多被称为最终清算的实体正在给星系带来浩劫！
descriptions.en: Multiple entities known as Reckonings are wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

descriptions.zh: §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上的§H远古堡场§!已经到功能的极限了。为了应对附近的灵能威胁，很有必要进一步提升它的性能。这种新的§H宏伟堡场§!应该可以保护我们的人口不受§H灵能光环§!侵染。
descriptions.en: The §HAncient Ward§! on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§! has reached its functional limits. In order to deal with the nearby psionic threat, it will be necessary to enhance its capacities even further. This new §HGrand Ward§! shall be capable of protecting our population against the blight of §HPsionic Auras§!.

descriptions.zh:
科学家们认为，更先进的§H灵能压制§!科技可以进一步发展，用于抑制整个星团的§H灵能光环§!。

这项科技将使我们得以建造§H“虚境封印”§!。在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系建造如此强大的装置将会显著提高对灵能威胁的控制能力。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists theorize that more advanced §HPsionic Suppression§! technology can be developed to suppress §HPsionic Auras§! in entire star clusters.

This technology will allow us to construct a §H'Shroud Seal'§!. Building such a powerful device in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system will be a significant advancement in controlling the ongoing psionic menace.

descriptions.zh: 我们失去了对母星§H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的控制。作为我们主要的知识储备地和所有社会活动的中心，如果不夺回它，我们将无法继续推进我们的反灵能事业。
descriptions.en: We have lost control of our homeworld, §H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.

descriptions.zh:
对§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的战争迫在眉睫。

这场灵能浩劫必须从根源上解决。我们必须先在§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系内建造一座虚境封印，以此中和掉灵能光环；只有这样我们才能踏足，并将其从这个星系里净化掉。
descriptions.en:
War against the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§! is now upon us.

The psionic scourge must be quelled at its source. We must first construct a Shroud Seal in the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system, thereby neutralizing the Psionic Aura; only then can we move in and purge this menace from this galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
拆除§H虚境封印§!是为了安抚§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的必要牺牲，但该举措也只是缓兵之计。如果我们想再次踏足他们的领土并净化§H灵能光环§!就必须把这座建筑重建起来。

§P重建将会视为冒犯行为。我们必须做好一切反扑的准备。§!
descriptions.en:
Dismantling our §HShroud Seal§! was a necessary sacrifice to placate the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!, but this measure was only a ploy for time. The structure must be rebuilt before we can enter their territory and purge it of §HPsionic Auras§!.

§PReconstruction will be seen as an act of aggression. We must be ready for any retaliation.§!

descriptions.zh: 要新建一座灵督城邦，需要将一支有指挥官领导且规模足够的军事舰队派遣到可用的恒星系中，然后在§H舰队界面§!中选择相关命令。
descriptions.en: To establish a new Mindwarden Enclave, send a Commander-led military fleet of sufficient size into an eligible system and select the command in §HFleet View§!.

descriptions.zh: 该§H终末光环§!正受到能衰装置的挑战，这些外来机械可衰减灵能。我等受其主宰之意志所驱，必须拆解这些亵渎之器。
descriptions.en: The §HAura of the End§! is being challenged by foreign devices capable of psionic attenuation. The will of our patron compels us to dismantle these blasphemous machines.
